applyTo: "src/modules/**/*.ts"

# Domain Overview Instructions

Online Shop Phase 1 supports storefront browsing, cart, checkout, COD/manual payment, manual shipment, admin management, audit logs, and customer order tracking. Keep data model seller-ready without building full marketplace complexity.

## Agent checklist

- Confirm the owning module before editing data.
- Preserve lifecycle correctness.
- Keep customer and provider data private.
- Add audit logs for admin and financial state changes.
